audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer read 'Skill' for all seven rows while the content layer read 'LeBlanc' for all seven — the page answered 'who wins Level 1' two different ways. Neither was right: Karma owns the first two levels.
audit.why: Mantra is available at level 1 and costs no skill point, and Inner Flame reaches 950 versus LeBlanc's 700-range Q. Focused Resolve is a flat 12s at every rank. Once LeBlanc has W and E, and especially after first item, the burst wins — consistent with 53.17% over 4053 games.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-2 -> Karma (rating 4/10), row 3 -> Skill, rows 4 through 2+ items -> LeBlanc, with every why rewritten to argue the row it sits under and win[0..2] moved to match.
sources: brief enemyKit R text 'Mantra is available at level 1 and does not require a skill point'

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] said Karma's level 6 'unlocks' RW/RQ. She has had Mantra since level 1; level 6 only ranks it up.
audit.why: Enemy R cooldown 40/38/36/34 with Mantra available from level 1 — the level 6 change is 40s to 38s, not an unlock.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to state the real numbers: your Mimic is 45s at rank 1; her sixth level buys two seconds off Mantra.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page attributed Karma's root to 'Soulflare (RQ)' in four places. Karma's root is Focused Resolve (W) — a 675-range tether that roots only if it is not broken. Mantra Q is a delayed damage zone with a slow, and it does not root.
audit.why: Enemy W text: 'Karma creates a tether... If the tether is not broken, the enemy will be rooted.' Enemy Q Mantra bonus: 'creating a cataclysm which deals damage after a short delay.'
audit.corrected: spikes[0], mid, whys[2], wants.you[1], dosFull[1].d and breakdown.cooldowns all now name Focused Resolve (W) and tell you to leave its 675 range. Also added: Focused Resolve reveals you, which is why a straight-line clone bluff toward tower fails.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT) and was template text.
audit.why: Focused Resolve is a flat 12s at all ranks; Inspire is 10/9.5/9/8.5/8; Gathering Fire reduces Mantra's cooldown whenever her abilities damage a target.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with all three numbers and the consequence: poking you costs her nothing because it accelerates Mantra.
sources: brief enemyKit cooldowns and passive text

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal anywhere despite Mantra W healing her.

notes: Both chart layers were wrong in different directions (full: all Skill; content: all LeBlanc). Flipped to Karma/Karma/Skill/LeBlanc/LeBlanc/LeBlanc/LeBlanc as one atomic group. win[3..6] already read 'LeBlanc', so the phases[3..6].side moves to LeBlanc need no paired win edit — they resolve an existing disagreement rather than creating one. 'Soulflare' appears nowhere in Riot's data for Karma and the root it was credited with belongs to Focused Resolve (W); every instance was corrected. Gathering Fire's exact Mantra cooldown reduction per hit is not in the kit text, so I wrote the direction ('shortens Mantra every time she damages you') without a number.
